scope: Read-only resource configuration/Monitoring; bounded logs aggregated in memory; no raw private records exported

metric_descriptors.description: Billable time aggregated across all container instances. For a given container instance, billable time occurs when the container instance is starting or at least one request is being processed. Billable time is rounded up to the nearest 100 milliseconds. Examples: If a revision with 2 container instances has been continuously serving traffic in the last minute, the value is 2s/s with the default "rate" aligner. If a single request lasting 30ms was received by a revision in the past minute, it is rounded up to 100ms and averaged to 1.7ms/s over the minute with the default "rate" aligner.
